Per-game EQ that follows your focus.

A tiny Windows tray app for Equalizer APO. Alt-tab into a game and its EQ profile switches on, alt-tab out and your default comes back.

Download for Windows View source

Free and open source (MIT). Windows 10/11, requires Equalizer APO. All releases

Built to stay out of the way

Set it up once, then forget it's running.

Follows focus

Rules by exe name, window title or both. Works with Game Pass and Store games too.

Anti-cheat friendly

Never opens, reads or injects into game processes. Only window APIs and system counters.

Featherweight

Event driven: 0% CPU when idle and well under 1 MB of memory. One small exe, nothing to install.

Community presets

Download voted EQ presets for popular games straight from the app.

Setup in three steps

Full details in the README.

  1. In your Equalizer APO config.txt, add Include: game.txt after your headphone correction, and give your account Modify permission on the config folder.

  2. Run EQ Loadout, open Settings from the tray icon and use Get presets to grab a preset for your game.

  3. Add a rule: pick the game from the running-app list and choose the preset as its profile. That's it.
